name: TIME
doc: Global time since the engine has started, in seconds. It repeats after every 3,600 seconds (which can be changed with the rollover setting). It's affected by time_scale but not by pausing. If you need a TIME variable that is not affected by time scale, add your own global shader uniform and update it each frame.

name: POSITION
doc: Camera position, in world space.

name: RADIANCE
doc: Radiance cubemap. Can only be read from during background pass. Check !AT_CUBEMAP_PASS before using.

name: AT_HALF_RES_PASS
doc: true when rendering to half resolution pass.

name: AT_QUARTER_RES_PASS
doc: true when rendering to quarter resolution pass.

name: AT_CUBEMAP_PASS
doc: true when rendering to radiance cubemap.

name: LIGHT0_ENABLED
doc: true if LIGHT0 is visible and in the scene. If false, other light properties may be garbage.

name: LIGHT1_ENABLED
doc: true if LIGHT1 is visible and in the scene. If false, other light properties may be garbage.

name: LIGHT2_ENABLED
doc: true if LIGHT2 is visible and in the scene. If false, other light properties may be garbage.

name: LIGHT3_ENABLED
doc: true if LIGHT3 is visible and in the scene. If false, other light properties may be garbage.

name: LIGHT0_ENERGY
doc: Energy multiplier for LIGHT0.

name: LIGHT1_ENERGY
doc: Energy multiplier for LIGHT1.

name: LIGHT2_ENERGY
doc: Energy multiplier for LIGHT2.

name: LIGHT3_ENERGY
doc: Energy multiplier for LIGHT3.

name: LIGHT0_DIRECTION
doc: Direction that LIGHT0 is facing.

name: LIGHT1_DIRECTION
doc: Direction that LIGHT1 is facing.

name: LIGHT2_DIRECTION
doc: Direction that LIGHT2 is facing.

name: LIGHT3_DIRECTION
doc: Direction that LIGHT3 is facing.

name: LIGHT0_COLOR
doc: Color of LIGHT0.

name: LIGHT1_COLOR
doc: Color of LIGHT1.

name: LIGHT2_COLOR
doc: Color of LIGHT2.

name: LIGHT3_COLOR
doc: Color of LIGHT3.

name: LIGHT0_SIZE
doc: Angular diameter of LIGHT0 in the sky. Expressed in radians. For reference, the sun from earth is about .0087 radians (0.5 degrees).

name: LIGHT1_SIZE
doc: Angular diameter of LIGHT1 in the sky. Expressed in radians.

name: LIGHT2_SIZE
doc: Angular diameter of LIGHT2 in the sky. Expressed in radians.

name: LIGHT3_SIZE
doc: Angular diameter of LIGHT3 in the sky. Expressed in radians.

name: PI
doc: A PI constant (3.141592). A ratio of a circle's circumference to its diameter and amount of radians in half turn.

name: TAU
doc: A TAU constant (6.283185). An equivalent of PI * 2 and amount of radians in full turn.

name: E
doc: An E constant (2.718281). Euler's number and a base of the natural logarithm.
